definitions.explanation: A shape or figure, particularly in mathematical or geometric contexts. Includes circles, triangles, squares, and other geometric forms.

examples.japanese: {三角形|さんかくけい}は{最|もっと}も{基本的|きほんてき}な{図形|ずけい}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: A triangle is one of the most basic geometric shapes.

examples.japanese: この{図形|ずけい}の{面積|めんせき}を{求|もと}めなさい。
examples.english: Find the area of this figure.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{様々|さまざま}な{図形|ずけい}を{使|つか}って{絵|え}を{描|か}いた。
examples.english: The children drew pictures using various shapes.

notes:
USAGE: {図形|ずけい} is commonly used in mathematical and educational contexts. It refers specifically to geometric shapes and figures.

COMMON GEOMETRIC SHAPES:
- {三角形|さんかくけい} (triangle)
- {四角形|しかくけい} (quadrilateral)
- {円|えん} (circle)
- {長方形|ちょうほうけい} (rectangle)
- {正方形|せいほうけい} (square)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図形|ずけい}を{描|えが}く (to draw a figure)
- {平面|へいめん}{図形|ずけい} (plane figure)
- {立体|りったい}{図形|ずけい} (solid figure, 3D shape)
